### Tactical Weapon Stacking & Citations
* **Street Line Special**: Holdout pistol (*SR6 Core*, p. 251) with concealed holster and personalized grip (+1 AR at close range).
* **Touch Spell Attacks**: Unarmed attack rolls for touch-range combat spells utilize Agility + Close Combat, bypassing physical armor soak (*SR6 Core*, p. 131).

## 2. High-Dice Pools Over 20 (Tabletop Audit)

Under official *Shadowrun Missions* guidelines, any dice pool exceeding 20 dice is subject to rules verification for stacking legality, modifier categories, and augmented limits.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(render_multi_modifier_interactions("velvet", threshold=2))
```

### Stacking Legality Summary

* **Social & Influence Pools**: Combines natural Charisma 10 (boosted to 14 via *Increase Attribute*) + Con / Influence skill ratings + Specializations (+2) + Adept Command Presence (+2 dice, +1 Edge) + First Impression (+2 dice). Social Edge discounts from *Cosmetic Control* reduce Edge Boost costs by 1 point (*Street Wyrd*, p. 34).
* **Sorcery & Conjuring**: Combines Magic (6) + Rating 3 Power Focus (+3) + Sorcery/Conjuring rating + Specializations (+2). The Power Focus functions as an un-typed tool bonus to effective Magic (*SR6 Core*, p. 247).
* **Drain Resistance**: Shinto/Musok tradition resists drain with Willpower + Charisma (*Street Wyrd*, p. 17). Under sustained attribute buffs (Willpower 9 + Charisma 14), drain soak pool reaches **23d6** (buying 5 hits), completely negating routine spellcasting and spirit binding drain.

## 3. Complex Mechanical Interplays Specific to Velvet

### I. Mystic Adept Power Point Allocation & Metamagic Suite
* **Source**: *SR6 Core*, p. 70 (Mystic Adept chargen), *Street Wyrd*, pp. 78, 121 (Initiation & Metamagics), and *Deadly Arts*, p. 28, 173.
* **Chargen Allocation**: Velvet allocated 2.0 Power Points at character creation via Character Points (Cosmetic Control R2, 2.0 PP) and +1.0 Power Point via Grade 1 Initiation at chargen (Linguistics 0.25, Command Presence 0.50, Cloak R1 0.25).
* **Initiation Grade 1 (*Power Point*)**: Grants +1.0 Power Point (*CRB*, p. 168), enabling Linguistics, Command Presence, and Cloak on Day 1.
* **Initiation Grade 2 (*Channeling*)**: Enables spirit inhabitation, granting physical attribute augmentation ($\lfloor \text{Force}/2 \rfloor$), wound penalty negation, and dual-natured status without losing sovereign control (*Street Wyrd*, p. 121).
* **Initiation Grade 3 (*Centering*)**: Adds Initiate Grade (+3) to Drain Resistance tests (*CRB*, p. 164).
* **Initiation Grade 4 (*Masking*)**: Opposes Assensing with Magic + Initiate Grade (10d6); disguises aura as mundane and masks bonded foci up to Initiate Grade (Force 4) (*CRB*, p. 165).
* **Initiation Grade 5 (*Stealth Effect*)**: Subtle casting: camouflages spell manifestations and adds Initiate Grade (+5) to the perception threshold to detect spellcasting (*Deadly Arts*, p. 173; *SRMG*, p. 75).

### II. SRM Monthly Expenses & Coven Decay Protocol
* **Source**: *Shadowrun Missions Guide v2.4*, pp. 17–19, 47, 59–60.
* **Monthly Obligations**: Every second official SRM mission, recurring expenses are settled:
  * Low Lifestyle: ¥2,000/mo.
  * Hooder Quality (Rating 3): ¥3,000/mo allocated to community clinics and refugee grids (*Sixth World Companion*, p. 132).
  * Coven Maintenance: Forgone during the 4-month decay from Loyalty 8 down to Loyalty 4, saving ¥2,400/mo in dues and liberating 4 Major Downtime Actions for rapid-fire initiations. Stabilizes at Loyalty 4 (¥350/mo dues, 1 Minor Downtime Action).
* **Downtime Action Resolution**:
  * **Major Downtime Actions**: 100% dedicated to Metamagic Initiation and Spiritual Quests without coven blockage.
  * **Minor Downtime Actions**: *Working for the People*—funded directly by the ¥3,000 Hooder obligation, generating **+1 Karma** at no additional nuyen charge (*SRMG v2.4*, p. 19), plus spirit binding.

### III. Sustained Spells & Spirit Channeling Strategy
* **Source**: *SR6 Core*, p. 73 (*Focused Concentration*), p. 147 (Spirit Force limits), and *Street Wyrd*, p. 122.
* **Focused Concentration (Rating 3)**: Sustains *Increase Attribute (Charisma)* and *Increase Attribute (Willpower)* or *Increase Reflexes* simultaneously without suffering the standard -2 dice pool sustaining penalty per spell (*SR6 Core*, p. 73).
* **Maximum Bound Spirit Capacity**: $\text{Magic } (6) \times 3 = \mathbf{18}\text{ Total Force}$ across all active bound spirits (*SR6 Core*, p. 147).
